## Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan (AASL)

• Australian Apprentices needing additional cost-of-living support may apply for an Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan, previously known 
as a Trade Support Loan.

• The apprentice must be completing an apprenticeship listed on the Australian Apprenticeships Priority List.

• The Apprentice may borrow up to **$27,048 (2026/27)** interest free (annually indexed) over their 4-year apprenticeship.

• Repayments begin when the repayment threshold of **$69,528 (2026/27)** is reached and will receive a 20% reduction of the balance when 
apprenticeship successfully completed.

• Refer to the Australian Apprenticeship Support Loans Guidelines for full details.

## Off-the-Job Tutorial, Mentor and Interpreter Assistance

• Off-the-Job, Tutorial, Mentor, and Interpreter Assistance is provided to support 
Australian Apprentices with disability who are experiencing difficulty with the off-thejob component of their Australian Apprenticeship.

• Payments are made to the Apprentices’ Registered Training Organisation who facilitate 
the off-the-job training.

o Tutorial Services, $38.50 per hour up to a maximum of $5,500 per year.

o Mentor or Interpreter Services, $38.50 per hour up to a maximum of $5,500 
per year.
